hero.title: O-1 Visa USA: Work legally in the United States with an outstanding professional background
ledes: You have earned recognition, led major projects, published your work, received awards, or become a recognized expert in your field. Your professional achievements could open the door to career opportunities in the United States.

The O-1 visa is designed for individuals with extraordinary ability and allows qualified professionals to work legally in the United States. If you have built an outstanding career, this may be the ideal pathway to live and work in the USA.
At D4U Immigration, we transform your professional achievements into a competitive immigration case.
Request a free profile evaluation and find out whether the O-1 visa is the right option for you.

whatIs.title: What is the O-1 visa?
intro: The O-1 visa is a temporary work visa for professionals who demonstrate extraordinary ability in their field. It is available to individuals who have achieved national or international recognition in areas such as:
items: Science
Education
Business
Athletics
Arts
Motion Picture
Television
whatIs.closing: Its purpose is to allow these professionals to legally work in the United States.
whatIs.imageAlt: Couple holding an American flag in front of a house

whoCan.title: Who can apply for an O-1 visa?
whoCan.lede: The O-1 visa is intended for professionals whose careers demonstrate excellence and significant recognition. Professionals who may qualify include:
whoCan.imageAlt: Doctors in front of a hospital

requirements.title: What are the O-1 visa requirements?
requirements.lede: To qualify for an O-1 visa, applicants must demonstrate extraordinary ability through evidence recognized under U.S. immigration law. Depending on the visa category, supporting evidence may include:
items: National or international awards
Publications in professional journals or industry publications
Media coverage
Participation as a judge or reviewer
Original contributions of major significance
Membership in prestigious organizations
Leadership in significant projects
High salary or compensation compared to others in the field
Recognition from experts in the profession
requirements.note: *Applicants are not required to meet every criterion. Each case is evaluated based on the overall strength of the professional record.

benefits.title: What are the benefits of the O-1 visa?
items: Work legally in the United States
Continue practicing your profession in the U.S.
Renew the visa as long as eligibility requirements continue to be met
Bring your spouse and children under O-3 dependent status
Build an international career in the United States

greenCard.title: Can the O-1 visa be used while waiting for a Green Card?
paragraphs: In many cases, yes. Professionals who have already started—or plan to start—an EB-1 or EB-2 NIW petition may use the O-1 visa as a strategy to live and work legally in the United States while waiting for their immigrant petition to move forward.
Depending on your eligibility and immigration strategy, this option may allow you to relocate to the United States before obtaining permanent residency.
When applicable, applicants may also request USCIS Premium Processing, significantly reducing the petition processing time. Please note that every case is unique and must be evaluated individually.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about the O-1 visa

items.q: Do I need a U.S. company to apply for an O-1 visa?
items.a: There are different ways to structure an O-1 petition depending on your specific circumstances. During your evaluation, our team will explain the most appropriate strategy for your profile.

items.q: Does the O-1 visa allow me to work in the United States?
items.a: Yes. The purpose of the O-1 visa is to allow qualified professionals to legally perform their work in the United States.

items.q: How long does the O-1 visa process take?
items.a: Processing times vary depending on each case and current USCIS timelines. Premium Processing may also be available to expedite the review of the petition.

items.q: Can I renew my O-1 visa?
items.a: Yes. The O-1 visa may be renewed as long as you continue to meet the eligibility requirements.
Yes. Your spouse and unmarried children may apply for O-3 dependent visas.

items.q: Does the O-1 visa lead to a Green Card?
items.a: No. The O-1 is a temporary nonimmigrant work visa. However, it can be part of a long-term immigration strategy that later includes an EB-1 or EB-2 NIW petition for permanent residence.

items.q: What is the difference between the O-1 and the EB-1?
items.a: The O-1 is a temporary work visa, while the EB-1 is an immigrant visa category that may lead to lawful permanent residence (a Green Card).

items.q: What is the difference between the O-1 and the EB-2 NIW?
items.a: The O-1 allows professionals to work temporarily in the United States, while the EB-2 NIW is an immigrant visa category that may lead to permanent residency for qualified applicants.
